data.one_liner: Adds persistent storage to CachedQuery using Sqflite
data.what_it_does: It stores query results on disk as JSON and can deserialize them back to Dart objects. The storage is initialized once and then all CachedQuery queries are automatically persisted.
use_when: You want queries to survive app restarts
You already use CachedQuery for caching
You need a simple SQL-backed storage without writing raw SQL
avoid_when: You need a key‑value store or secure storage instead of SQL
strengths: Built on Sqflite, no extra dependencies
weaknesses: Relies on Sqflite, so only works on mobile/desktop
